synth.executive_verdict: OpenCITE today is a well-built free web app bolted to a paid API that no customer can reach: the only sellable thing (credits spent through an API key on /api/search, /api/citations, /api/ids and the MCP server) has no key-mint UI, no published package, no docs page, a pack rail that leaves buyers on plan=free, and a database that has been paused for roughly ten weeks on a Free-plan Supabase project with no backup anywhere else. Production is an unreproducible mid-sprint snapshot of the uncommitted v0.44 tree, and a single click on any of three open Dependabot PRs would overwrite it with the pre-teardown engine. The web subscriptions (Free/Student/Pro) sell quotas and sources the browser already gives away unmetered, so they cannot convert and their copy is false; Student is unpurchasable by construction. Pack pricing ($0.67-1.00 per 1k queries) is below OpenAlex's new metered cost, and the server runs OpenAlex keyless on a ~$0.10/day allowance that dies after ~50 all-tier queries. Traffic is zero, so the first dollar is a distribution event, not an engineering one; the engineering only has to stop a developer from bouncing off a dead sign-in, a 401, an empty result set, or a missing legal page. The single most important thing to do, today, is to resume Supabase OpenC_Auth and take an off-site dump before the 90-day one-click restore window closes (estimated 2026-09-15..22); everything else in this roadmap is moot if the ledger is lost. After that, the sequence is: freeze the deploy footgun and go Vercel Pro (same day), commit the exact tree prod runs so main==prod before touching any code (days 1-2), make the money path correct and honest (days 2-7), ship the Developers panel + legal pages + npm package (days 8-14), walk the whole journey with a real $10 charge on a second Google account (day 14), then spend days 15-30 putting a working Claude Desktop demo in front of ~30 named developers and researchers. Realistic 30-day effort is ~65-70 founder-hours with Claude Code, not the 54-59 the source plans claimed; the first external $10 pack is a day 21-35 outcome with an explicit day-30 decision gate on whether the pack SKU has any pull.

# OpenCITE — Final Roadmap (synthesized 2026-09-04)

**Product decision of record:** one SKU — prepaid API/MCP credit packs for developers and AI-native researchers who work inside Claude Desktop / Cursor. The web app stays free, unmetered and unchanged (it is the demo). Student/Pro subscriptions are hidden behind a flag, not sold. Every step below either unblocks sign-in → pay → mint key → call, or makes the metered answer worth paying for.

**Operating rules that shape this plan:** no branches, all commits to `main` only when Shahbaz says go, no local builds/tests/`npm install` by the agent (Shahbaz runs `npm install` himself for the dependency bump), verify on live prod. The one local node invocation is `scripts/wiki/build-machine-map.mjs --check`, which the pre-commit hook runs anyway. Git production deploys stay DISABLED for the entire 30 days; the only deploy path is `vercel --prod` from a known SHA.

**Effort honesty:** Week 0 ≈ 3 h (dashboards, Shahbaz only) · Days 1-7 ≈ 31 h · Days 8-30 ≈ 34 h · **30-day total ≈ 68 h**. Days 31-90 ≈ 70 h. If the schedule slips, drop in this order: Gallica fix → front-door rewrite → legal pages down to ToS+Privacy only.

---

## Week 0 — TODAY (Shahbaz, dashboards only, ~3 h). Nothing else starts until W0.1 is done.

### W0.1 Resume Supabase and take the first off-site dump — 1 h — closes F3
- Supabase dashboard → project OpenC_Auth (`cjnmoupvlqcqigmabanq`) → **Resume**. Wait for ACTIVE_HEALTHY (MCP `get_project`).
- Verify: `SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM users), (SELECT count(*) FROM api_keys), (SELECT count(*) FROM processed_events), (SELECT count(*) FROM library_items), (SELECT count(*) FROM search_history), (SELECT count(*) FROM _prisma_migrations);` — expect 3 migration rows.
- If "Tenant or user not found" persists: reset the database password in Supabase, update `POSTGRES_PRISMA_URL` + `POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING` in Vercel prod, and rewrite `ops_credentials.md`.
- Dump immediately: `supabase db dump --db-url "<session-pooler URL>" -f opencite-2026-09-04.sql`; store outside Vercel/Supabase (local + cloud drive). Repeat weekly until Supabase Pro.
- **Acceptance (live):** sign in with Google on citation.today succeeds; Vercel runtime errors show no new `PrismaClientInitializationError`. On this first sign-in, also confirm the unexplained 2026-07-05 `"iss" missing` OAuth failure does NOT recur (it is independent of the DB pause). If it does, stop and root-cause `api/auth/handler.js` before any checkout work.
- **Fallback:** if the one-click window has already closed, download the `.backup`, create a new project, `psql` restore, rewrite both `POSTGRES_*` vars (+3 h; all users re-login).

### W0.2 Vercel: Pro, deploy freeze, WAF, analytics, env vars — 1 h — closes F7, F25, F15 (interim), F24 (analytics half), F56
- Upgrade team `team_5dTC8ShmkJ46A18D9cgBQXre` to **Pro** ($20/mo). Hobby fair-use already forbids the live Ko-fi widget + checkout; Pro also lifts the 12-function cap.
- Project → Settings → Git → **Ignored Build Step = `exit 0`** for production (or disconnect production from Git). Do not re-enable until day 90 review.
- Close Dependabot PRs #6/#7/#8 with the comment "main is not the deploy source until the v0.44 tree is committed; bumps taken in-tree." Never merge them.
- Firewall → add one rate-limit rule: path `/api/proxy`, per-IP, 60 requests / 10 min.
- Analytics → **Enable Web Analytics** (component is already mounted at `src/App.jsx:460`).
- Env (Production): `OPENCITE_MAILTO=<role address>`, `NCBI_API_KEY` (free, ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/account), `EUROPEANA_API_KEY` (free, europeana.eu/api — `serverKeys.js:10` already injects it; without it Europeana silently drops out of the paid tier), `OPENALEX_API_KEY` (register at openalex.org; free key = $1/day).
- **Acceptance (live):** `vercel teams ls` shows pro; Vercel Analytics API no longer returns 404; the three PRs show closed; a push to main produces no production deployment.

### W0.3 Stripe dashboard prep — 1 h — prerequisite for D2/D3

# Cut list — what this roadmap deliberately does NOT do

## Cut for the full 90 days
- **Web metering / plan-based source gating in the SPA** (~16 h): routing browser search through `/api/search` burns the OpenAlex budget and creates no reason-to-buy. The web app stays free and unmetered; it is the demo. (Closes F1/F5/F9 by deletion of the copy, not by building gating.)
- **Student plan and any verification provider** (SheerID, manual upload): hide the card behind `SUBSCRIPTIONS_ENABLED=false`; no code beyond the flag.
- **Human Pro/Free subscription rail**: flag off. Re-evaluate only at the day-90 review with usage data, and only on features the free app lacks.
- **Fixing the dead adapters** BASE, Thaqalayn, LA Referencia, PANGAEA, Open Context: quarantine (`serverSafe:false`, `corpusSize` dropped, v0.44 T5 pattern). No Vercel Secure Compute / BASE IP registration, no LA Referencia negotiation. Only Met (one token) and Gallica (existing regex helpers) are fixed, because the pitch names heritage archives.
- **Any ranking-engine revival** (BM25F, RRF, semantic, synonyms, gate, v0.35 branch): the v0.35 tip is tagged for archival only. The only ordering change is static lane order + a stricter Crossref term match.
- **Merging or rebasing the three Dependabot PRs**: closed; bumps taken in-tree and shipped via CLI.
- **Native app / IAP rail / App Store copy / `platform.js`**: deleted from the bundle.
- **CLI or PyPI package under the name `opencite`** (taken): npm name is `opencite-mcp`.
- **Institutional/library outreach, invoicing, provenance features**: no persona evidence, months away.
- **Python/Rust/Go rewrite, embeddings service, hosted-model work**: the app is IO-bound.
- **Competing on price with free OpenAlex-wrapper MCPs**: reprice up to $5/1k and sell heritage breadth + citation formats + coverage-honest billing.
- **New sprint logs with self-declared status headers**: status lives only in `docs/wiki/10-Sprints/Index.md`.

## Cut from the 30-day window (moved to Days 31-90)
- `credit_events` journal, orphan-reconciliation cron, `meta.requestId`, `ApiKey.plan` drop (v0.45 T1/T2/T8): valuable at ten customers, irrelevant at zero. Only v0.45 T3 (P2002 scoping) and T4 (atomic grant) ride along on D2.
- Remote Streamable-HTTP `/api/mcp`, OAuth, Claude/ChatGPT directory applications: need a remote endpoint + deletion endpoint; npm + Smithery/Glama/PulseMCP instead.
- `DELETE /api/user/account`, JSON export, Stripe Customer Portal, Stripe Tax registrations: privacy page names an email deletion path meanwhile; capture billing address only.
- Proxy allowlist derivation test, exact-list trusted origins, admin allowlist server-side: real but not first-dollar blockers; the D7 byte budget + WAF rule are the interim controls.
- Full wiki / machine twin / wiki-gh / Health-Dashboard / Adapter-Health-Matrix rewrite: only the fragment edits needed to make `--check` green (D1.1).
- a11y, nag UX, perf hygiene, ResultCard memo, dedup test rewrite, progressive reveal, degraded-state banner, CSP enforce flip.
- Europe PMC / Unpaywall / OpenCitations adoption; ONB/BnF CQL fix; D6 ToS review for all serverSafe sources.
- Supabase Pro ($25/mo): the daily `/api/health` keepalive cron + weekly dump are enough under 100 users; spend the money on Vercel Pro, which is mandatory.
- Counsel review of the ToS: publish plain-language pages now; book counsel at day 90 if revenue appears or before any $200 pack to an EU customer.
- Full v0.37 funnel (per-IP trial, forced `/auth/connect-ai`): replaced by the signed-in 20-credit grant + 402 `upgrade_url`.

## Explicitly rejected ideas from the source plans
- Plan 0's day-13 single blob commit: rejected in favour of committing the prod snapshot first (D1.3), so every later change is a small reviewable commit.
- Plan 1's "run v0.45 in full before the key UI" (~20 h of ledger plumbing ahead of the revenue mechanism): rejected; only T3/T4 kept.
- Plan 2's "re-enable Git production deploys after the push": rejected; Git deploys stay frozen for 90 days, CLI `vercel --prod` from a SHA is the only path.
- Plan 0's "10 free credits by copy change" as the primary path: kept only as the fallback if the lazy grant slips; the 402→pack loop needs a real free allowance to terminate in.
- Plan 0's "refund clawback deferred to 90-day with a manual procedure": rejected; it is ~1 h on D2 and a refunded $200 pack keeping 60k credits is not acceptable even at one customer.
- Plan 1's "run migrations against a Supabase branch first": requires Supabase Pro; the 30-day window adds no migration (health handler is code-only, clawback uses existing columns).

# Completeness critique — OpenCITE 90-day roadmap

## Findings not actually closed (tag ≠ fix)
- **F8/F10/F22/F54 breaker → "full" charge.** `api/search.js:238-239` removes circuit-open adapters from *eligibility and the denominator* (by design, v0.38 comment :236-237). D5-6's zero-adapter guard does not touch this: after five OpenAlex 429s a paid caller is billed 1.0x for Crossref+DOAJ. Add one line: pass `cbDropped` to `computeCoverage` as failed (or cap the denominator shrink). Not in any step.
- **F29 legal resale conflict** is "documented-risk keep" for IA/BnF/Open Library while D14 sells real money. BnF's mandatory attribution is cheap to satisfy (public Sources page); schedule it before D14, not D50-70.
- **F109**: F-100 close, the two "WS4 deferred" comments, and `IDRESOLVE_CANONICALIZE` decision are never scheduled.
- **F77 is mis-sequenced.** `eeda115` is confirmed unreachable (`git fsck --unreachable` hits it) and 88 days old — past the default 30-day unreachable-reflog expiry; any auto-gc deletes it. Tagging is 10 seconds; move to Week 0, not D1.1.
- **F82/F28**: refund clawback at D2 with "log + revoke keys manually" leaves no `flagged_at` column — the manual procedure is undocumented.

## Unverified assumptions load-bearing for a step
1. **W0.2 "Ignored Build Step = exit 0" + "CLI `vercel --prod` is the only path."** Vercel runs the ignore command for CLI deployments too; the deploy could be skipped. Verify: after setting it, run `vercel --prod` and confirm a new deployment builds (fallback `--force`, or an ignore command keyed on `$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF`).
2. **W0.1 `supabase db dump`** requires Docker on the machine; verify `docker ps` or use `pg_dump` against the session pooler.
3. **D7 KV limiter.** `ratelimit.js` fails OPEN when `KV_REST_API_URL`/`UPSTASH_*` are unset (`kv.js:18-19`). Nothing verifies KV is provisioned in prod — the "40 bogus keys → 429" acceptance will fail silently. Verify: `vercel env ls production | grep -E 'KV_|UPSTASH'`.
4. **D3 pack repricing** assumes webhook credit amounts come from `CREDIT_PACKS[metadata.pack]` (confirmed `webhook.js:132-139`), so the new SKUs must exist in `plans.js` before the Stripe prices are used — W0.3 creates prices *before* D3 code exists; a test checkout in between would grant nothing.
5. **D12 `opencite-mcp` name** — npm registry returns 404 for both `opencite-mcp` and `opencite` today (available; verified).
6. **D5-6 lane ordering** is untested on any gold set — this is exactly the "speculative solution" CLAUDE.md says to confirm with Shahbaz first.
7. **W0.2 WAF 60 req/10 min on `/api/proxy`** will throttle legitimate web users: one search with ~8 proxied extension adapters = 8 requests, so ~7 searches per 10 min. Raise to ~300 or key on burst.
8. **W0.1 sign-in acceptance** depends on the unexplained 2026-07-05 `"iss" missing` OAuth failure not recurring — correctly flagged, but the roadmap has no fallback hour budgeted if it does.

## P0 sequenced too late
F2 (key UI) sits at D8-10 behind ~31 h of D1-D7. Nothing in D5-D7 is a first-dollar blocker except page size (D5, ~1 h) and plan=machine (D2, ~15 min).

## Cheaper first dollar all three planners missed
`GET/POST/DELETE /api/keys` already exists (`keys.js:41,50,70`). A concierge path needs no UI: W0.1 resume → Stripe **Payment Link** (no code) → Shahbaz runs `UPDATE users SET plan='machine', total_credits=...` → mints the key from the browser console with the session cookie → emails it with the `claude_desktop_config.json` block. ~2 h plus the D5 page-size thread. Ten hand-served customers validate demand before the 68-h build; the Developers panel then automates a proven path.

- D14 "small reviewable commits are fine" — every commit still needs an explicit ask; say so.
- D3 Ko-fi removal (`Layout.jsx:262-396`, not `index.html`) and D5 quarantines are product decisions — get the confirmation first.
